Thanks David — quick notes inline below and attached a tracked-redline.

On 2025-11-01 15:12, Elena Park wrote:
> - Firm price cap for the first 12 months (see Section 2)
We can agree to a price cap with the following constraints: (1) cap applies only to charges under this amendment, (2) escape clause for material cost increases on GPU-hours (force majeure style wording). I'll propose language that limits exposure but keeps the customer's ask intact.

> - Data residency language for EU-sourced customers
We can accept a scoped residency commitment (data-at-rest in EU region) for customer accounts provisioned in EU regions. Need to add standard carve-outs for logs/backups with 30-day notice. Ops will need to confirm replication details.

> - Audit windows and notice period for SOC evidence requests (shorten to 10 business days)
10 business days is tight; suggest 15 business days with an option for expedited handling (fee-based) if Alpha requires faster turnaround.

> - Clarification on liability cap carve-outs for third-party integrations
We should not broaden carve-outs beyond direct breach/third-party indemnities already in MSA. I'll tighten the wording.

Attached: redwood_redlines_v2.docx (tracked changes).

Karthik — please review Section 2 pricing language and advise on the financial/commitment impact.

I'll prepare a consolidated clean amendment for signature once we agree the final bullets.

Best,

Subject: Re: Proposed edits to MSA + Order Form for capacity increase

Elena / Tom — thanks for the fast turnaround. Per Marissa and Karthik's input, here's what Redwood can commit to for the amendment: 

1) Capacity: increase to 2x committed units starting 2026-01-01, provisioning window 10 business days after countersigned amendment.
2) Price cap: fixed unit price for the first 12 months of the amendment. Redwood will include a limited cost-pass-through clause for major hardware cost increases (to be narrowly defined).
3) Data residency: Redwood will commit to EU region at-rest residency for accounts provisioned in EU, with standard backup replication carve-outs (30-day notice).
4) Audit response: Redwood proposes 15 business days default with an expedited option (48-72 hour SLA) at cost if requested.
5) Liability: Redwood will accept limited carve-outs narrowly scoped to third-party integrations as proposed by Alpha; no expansion of indemnity obligations.

Next steps: Marissa will prepare a consolidated tracked-redline and a clean amendment for signature. Karthik will confirm final billing terms and attach a redlined order form with the pricing schedule. We aim to send the countersigned amendment by 2025-11-07 to meet Alpha's 11/10 provisioning target.

Please confirm if the above aligns and whether Alpha can target signature by ~11/07. If yes, Marissa will produce the clean copy today and I'll get the final pricing schedule from Karthik.

Attachments: amendment_clean_vfinal.docx

Thanks,
